newsitem.title: USA: No decisions on IMF quotas, SDRs in Denver-Rexrodt.
newsitem.headline: No decisions on IMF quotas, SDRs in Denver-Rexrodt.

text.p: The summit meeting of the Group of Seven industrialized nations here will touch on the issue of reform of international organisations, but no decisions are expected yet, German economics minister Guenter Rexrodt said.
Rexrodt told a breakfast briefing on Saturday morning, "The reform of international institutions remains on the agenda, issues such as IMF quotas and an equitable issue of special drawing rights."

The International Monetary Fund is looking to raise its quotas to gain more regular funding. An issue of special drawing rights, the IMF's currency, is also being considered to allow those countries which have joined the IMF since the last SDR issue to have some of the reserve currency.

Rexrodt said that he expected decisions on this to be made at the annual meeting of the World bank and IMF in Hong Kong in September. "But clarity on this issue will be a matter for the government leaders," he said.
